sentences.en: The government acted boldly to deal with the outlaw uprising.
sentences.zh: 政府大胆地镇压了叛乱分子。

sentences.en: The Mormons have outlawed polygamy, but some adherents still practice it.
sentences.zh: 摩门教宣布一夫多妻制非法，但仍有信徒私下实行。

sentences.en: The local government outlawed the production of alcoholic beverages.
sentences.zh: 当地政府禁止生产酒精饮料。

senses.zh: 歹徒；罪犯；亡命之徒；被剥夺法律保护者
宣布…为不合法；将…放逐；剥夺…的法律保护

mnemonic: 合成词：out（出）+law（法律）→超出法律范围→宣布…为非法
